observed_metadata_gaps_and_review_points: The workflow's metadata-presence gate passed for all 17 pinned source-test runtime packages; this means every package exposed either a License field or a license classifier, not that an exact SPDX expression or complete NOTICE analysis was performed.

packaging 24.2 has a null License field and both Apache/BSD license classifiers; the applicable license expression should be confirmed from the exact distribution documentation before any redistribution.
multipledispatch 1.0.0 reports License='BSD' but provides no license classifier; the precise BSD variant/notice should be checked before redistribution.

numpy 1.26.4 and scipy 1.14.1 expose full license text fields and BSD classifiers; their binary wheels may bundle third-party numerical libraries. Bundled OpenBLAS/LAPACK/libgfortran notices and exact wheel contents need separate review if the environment or binaries are redistributed.
tqdm 4.67.1 declares dual MPL-2.0 AND MIT metadata; preserve both applicable license notices if redistributing the package.
importlib-metadata 4.13.0 and zipp 3.21.0 have null License fields but carry Apache and MIT classifiers respectively; this is metadata presence, not a full source-notice audit.
